errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа пет категорийни данни
errors.evidence: The categories are on the vertical axis, while the horizontal axis represents the numerical values. The description reverses the roles of the axes.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени азбучно по етикетите на категориите.
errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted alphabetically. Their order appears to be arbitrary.

errors.text_span: Височината на всеки стълб представлява числова стойност
errors.evidence: The chart uses horizontal bars, so their length, not height, represents the numerical value.
The legend shows four colors: light blue (Хърватия), green (Румъния), orange (Гърция), and dark blue (България). None of the colors is black (черно).

errors.text_span: Най-високият стълб, маркиран с червено, за “Причини за заокулчване на стоки от сивата икономика (QD9)”, достига стойност 479
errors.evidence: The highest bar in the entire chart corresponds to the category 'Купувани стоки и услуги от сивата икономика (QD7)' for Greece (orange bar), with a value of 630. The bar with value 479 is not the highest.

errors.text_span: докато най-ниският е с нулева стойност за “Видове не декларирани дейности”.
errors.evidence: There is no bar with a value of zero on the chart. The lowest value shown is 22.
The phrase 'proportionally high' is subjective and constitutes an interpretation of the data, which is forbidden by the prompt.
When listing values for the last two categories, the description is incomplete. For 'Сектор...', it omits the values 44 and 22. For 'Видове...', it omits the value 44.

The description fails to identify the chart's structure as a grouped bar chart, where each category contains a group of four bars representing the four countries listed in the legend. This is a fundamental characteristic of the visualization.
The description does not provide any details about the value axis (horizontal axis), such as its lack of a label, its scale, or the fact that values are displayed at the end of each bar.

errors.text_span: заокулчване на услити от сивата икономика
errors.evidence: There are multiple transcription errors in the text, such as 'заокулчване' instead of 'закупуване' and 'услити' instead of 'услуги', which hinders readability.
